chapter: New York, Dallas and Kansas City
title: Tape 3: Baby Lovett, 18th and Vine, Tadd Dameron
summary: He talks about Baby Lovett, the 18th and Vine area, and Tadd Dameron arranging for Harlan Leonard.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: All right, so you were friendly with Baby Lovett?

Oh, yes. Baby Lovett and I would see eye-to-eye on a lot of different subjects and we'd talk to other guys around there, well, what's going on around there, 18th and Vine. That was the real focal point of all the cats playing around. Elnora's. All those people.
Who else was in Kansas City at that time.

Well -- Tadd Dameron. Tadd Dameron who used to arrange for Harlan Leonard and played a lot of his beautiful arrangements. And Jay McShann and the musicians with the famous Charlie Parker, and it was beautiful to know him, to play with him.
